newsitem.title: JAPAN: Matsushita half-year profit surges on weak yen.
newsitem.headline: Matsushita half-year profit surges on weak yen.

text.p: Giant consumer electronics group Matsushita Electric Industrial Co. said Tuesday it returned to profitability in the first half of its fiscal year, helped by the weak yen.

Matsushita, whose products are sold under the National, Panasonic and Technics brand names, reported a group net profit of 42.6 billion yen ($383 million) for the six months ended Sept. 30 -- a turnaround from a 132.9 billion yen ($1.19 billion) loss in the same period a year ago.
When the effects of the 1995 sale of an 80 percent stake in Hollywood studio MCA Inc were excluded, net profits jumped 36 percent year-on-year, Matsushita said.
